title: loopEvaluate
responsibility: Runs configured loop evaluators through the bounded command adapter, records their outcomes in the loop trace, and supports an explicit no-run inspection mode.

inputs.name: evaluateLoop.input
inputs.description: Identifies the loop state to read, which must not be closed. Optional root and now values select the repository and trace timestamp; setting runEvaluators to false skips configured commands, while omission runs them.

inputs.name: renderLoopEvaluation.result
inputs.description: Supplies a completed evaluation result for formatting. A skipped result and an empty results list select dedicated messages.

outputs.name: evaluateLoop
outputs.description: Resolves with the loop name, relative trace path, pass flag, and evaluator results; skipped is present only when runEvaluators is false. When execution is enabled, passed is true exactly when every result has exit code 0, including an empty result list; skipped mode always returns false.

outputs.name: renderLoopEvaluation
outputs.description: Formats the loop name and evaluator status for display; skipped results and empty result lists use dedicated messages. For non-empty results it lists status, evaluator id and title, command, and exit code, but omits stdout and stderr.
examples:
Loop: release
Result: passed

[passed] lint - Lint
  command: yarn lint
  exit code: 0

Loop: release
Evaluators: skipped (repository commands disabled)

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the loop file is absent, parsed state fails validation, or the loaded loop is marked closed.
